title: Mesh Clinic
summary: Parse an OBJ specimen in Rust, expose degenerate, duplicate, boundary, and non-manifold topology, apply a bounded repair plan, and keep rendering in the Web host.
question: Can Vooya keep irregular mesh parsing and topology work in a reusable Rust capability while the host remains free to render the resulting projection with SVG, WebGL, or WebGPU?
evidence: tobj parses the case-owned OBJ specimen inside Rust/WASM
Rust computes topology diagnostics and projected triangles
Vue renders only the structured snapshot
focused browser evidence covers specimen, repair, rotation, and reset

boundary.updatePattern: Vue dispatches one coarse action; Rust retains the mesh and emits one bounded snapshot for host rendering.

alternatives: plain TypeScript OBJ parser and topology walk
